record.paper_title: Selected Old Open Problems in General Topology
record.context_brief: Cardinality of Lindelöf spaces with Gδ-points
record.original_question: Let X be a Lindelöf topological space in which every point is a Gδ-point. Must the cardinality of X be at most 2^ω?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let X be a Lindelöf topological space (Hausdorff/Tychonoff) in which every point is a Gδ-point, i.e., for each x ∈ X there exists a countable family {U_n : n ∈ ω} of open subsets of X with {x} = ⋂_{n∈ω} U_n. (Recall that X is Lindelöf if every open cover of X has a countable subcover.) Must the cardinality of X satisfy |X| ≤ 2^ω?
artifact.status_search_result: Shelah (1978) constructed a consistent counterexample, and stronger consistent counterexamples were obtained by Gorelic (1993) and Tall (1995). Whether the bound |X| ≤ 2^ω can be proved in ZFC, and whether there is any consistent ZFC upper bound on the cardinality of Hausdorff Lindelöf spaces with all points Gδ, remain open. So the problem is partially solved (consistently negative) but the ZFC question is still open.

status_evidence.title: First-countable Lindelöf scattered spaces (survey context)
status_evidence.snippet: Shelah gave a consistent negative answer to Arhangelskii's question; Gorelic (1993) and Tall (1995) obtained further consistent results; the ZFC question remains open.
status_evidence.claim: Consistent counterexamples are known; ZFC version still open.

status_evidence.title: On the cardinality of almost discretely Lindelöf spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Arhangelskii's problem about cardinality of Lindelöf spaces of countable pseudocharacter and related partial results.
status_evidence.claim: Arhangelskii's problem on |X| ≤ 2^ω for Lindelöf spaces with Gδ points is a well-known open problem.
